ambiguity.description: It is unresolved whether digital-platform, program-management, and contingency or reserve costs must be included as distinct line items in total program capex.

patches.decision_note: The uncertainty concerns which cost categories and line items the capex mechanism includes, not persistence, components, or application contexts.
After correcting the ambiguity to VALUE, the client MODIFY resolves it by specifying the included line items; the additional RESUME is redundant under v0.6 replay.
